blurb: Guests experience scenic river views aboard the Lady Kate, a renovated riverboat with elegant indoor and outdoor spaces. The cruises include private events such as weddings, corporate events, and themed public cruises. The Lady Kate is wheelchair accessible on the main level and operates year-round, departing from Eagle Landing State Park in Haddam, CT.
extraNote: All events subject to 22% service charge and 7.35% CT prepared food and beverage sales tax · External food and beverages not permitted; vendors must provide certificate of insurance · Cruises depart promptly; arrive 30 minutes early; late arrivals may delay departure in extreme cases · Weather assessed day of cruise; if unsafe, event held dockside · Non-refundable initial payment of $2,000 due at contract signing for weddings · 25% of final bill due 9 months prior, 25% due 3 months prior, balance due 3 business days before wedding · Eagle Landing State Park, 14 Little Meadow Road, Haddam, CT 06438 · Year-round
